name: flatten_decode_field_order
description: Flattened path columns must reconstruct the nested object at the declared position of its group (n between p and q), with nested keys in path-column order (x before y). A decoder that rebuilds objects into unordered maps re-encodes lexicographically and both moves the group and sorts its leaves. Object key ordering is a preserved round-trip property, and flatten round-trip must reconstruct exact key order (SPEC lines 52, 905, 931).
